rule: Aspect set and configured add should ignore unknown fields and apply only provided fields, leaving omitted fields unchanged, consistent with the existing SoA set accessor contract.
question: What should aspect set and configured add do with unknown fields and omitted fields? Establish which existing field-accessor contract applies.
rationale: The SoA set function only writes keys present in the value object, so unknown fields are ignored and omitted fields are not overwritten. This is the existing field-accessor contract that aspect set and configured add should follow.
